title: Fujitsu High Performance CPU for the Post-K Computer
version: Official conference archive copy of Fujitsu's Hot Chips 30 presentation deck, rev. 1.2, dated 21 August 2018

passages.note: Fujitsu identifies the A64FX as the post-K processor, describes work with Arm on SVE, and specifies Armv8.2-A, 512-bit SVE, HBM2 and an on-chip Tofu controller.
